problems_addressed.specific_problem: Converting small rental deals into larger sales

quotable_insights: Real estate isn't heart surgery. It's really simple if you can figure it out.

episode_summary: Chris Wands shares his journey from handling small rental deals to leading a top-producing luxury real estate team in Miami. He emphasizes the importance of treating every client with the same level of service, leveraging technology for efficiency, and ensuring proper infrastructure before scaling a team. Chris also highlights the role of social media in maintaining client relationships and the significance of work-life balance.
